FX-SPINZOOM-001.says: Straight zoom 30 about the middle: every edge streaks outward, evenly; Radial Blur's zoom 30 as it was before D-838 (D-110's outward zoom), exactly.

FX-SPINZOOM-002.says: Fading zoom 30: the same streaks, fading as they run out, so the drawing itself stays stronger.

FX-SPINZOOM-003.says: Centered zoom 30: streaks both outward and inward, half as long each way.

FX-SPINZOOM-004.says: Rotate 30: every edge streaks clockwise only, so the line down the left edge streaks upward past its top and not past its foot.

FX-SPINZOOM-005.says: Rotate -30: anticlockwise, the line streaking past its foot instead.

FX-SPINZOOM-006.says: Scratch 30: both ways evenly; Radial Blur's spin 30, FX-RADIAL-001, exactly.

FX-SPINZOOM-007.says: Rotate fading 30: clockwise, fading as it goes.

FX-SPINZOOM-008.says: Straight zoom 60, quality 10: a fifth of the points, so the streaks break into separate copies.

FX-SPINZOOM-009.says: Rotate 30, quality 100: twice the points, smoother than FX-SPINZOOM-004.

FX-SPINZOOM-011.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4, rotate, linear, as a wheel spinning up.

FX-SPINZOOM-012.says: Rotate 30 about the top left corner, moved three pixels right: the centre moves with the drawing, and nothing is drawn left of it.

FX-SPINZOOM-013.says: Straight zoom -30: the points run outward from the pixel, so the streaks run inward, toward the centre.

FX-SPINZOOM-014.says: A directional blur, direction 90 and length 4, then rotate fading 30 about 0, 0: the grown layer is read, the centre still the drawing's corner.

FX-SPINZOOM-015.says: Rotate 360 about -1000, -1000: every path is longer than 255 pixels, so each takes the most points, 256.

FX-SPINZOOM-016.says: Amount 361, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-017.says: Amount -361, below -360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-018.says: Quality 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-019.says: Quality 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-020.says: Type "spin", which is Radial Blur's word, not one of these. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-021.says: Type "Rotate": the word is exact. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPINZOOM-022.says: Centre 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
